messages:
Aisha: FYI — I'm putting together a proposal for ML-serving structured logs + sampling. Goal: reduce token-level telemetry cost, keep SLO observability, and make PII redaction deterministic. Need quick feedback from eng-sre + eng-platform on schema and sampling heuristics.

Ben: +1. Can you call out which fields are required for Grafana / SLO dashboards? We should avoid logging raw prompts.

Aisha: Minimal fields we need for SLOs and cost analysis: `model`, `model_version`, `route`, `batch_id` (optional), `seq_len`, `tokens_generated`, `latency_ms`, `error`, `cost_estimate_units`, `prompt_hash`, `kv_cache_hit` (bool). Also `customer_tier` and `region` for routing/capacity. Everything else should be optional or sampled.

Clara: Agree. For alerting we rely on `latency_ms`, `error`, and `tokens_generated` aggregated by model+route. Make sure `prompt_hash` is a deterministic HMAC (no raw text).

Evan: For the sampling rules I'd suggest two layers: 1) ingress sampling (high volume routes) and 2) retention sampling (how long full JSON logs kept). Example: ingest sampler should do 1% baseline, bump to 10% for errors or seq_len>1000, and always keep 100% for `error==true` or `kv_cache_hit==false` for a short window so we can debug cache misses.

Aisha: Sketching a pipeline config we can enforce in the ingest proxy: 
```
{"ingest_rules": [{"match":{"route":"/v1/generate"}, "base_rate":0.01, "overrides": [{"condition":"error==true","rate":1.0},{"condition":"seq_len>1000","rate":0.1},{"condition":"tokens_generated>5000","rate":0.5}]}, {"match":{"route":"/v1/embed"}, "base_rate":0.001}]}
```

Ben: That looks reasonable. Couple of asks: 1) Add a `reason` field when an event is sampled in (why chosen). 2) Make sampling decisions idempotent by storing sample decision in KV for 5m when debugging distributed traces.

Aisha: Good call — will add `sample_reason` and `sample_decision_id`. For idempotency we can stamp `sample_decision_id` = HMAC(timestamp+request_id).

Clara: PII redaction rules: no raw prompt, no user email/phone fields. If a customer sends PII in structured metadata we should redact via schema whitelist. Proposed approach: only allow `user_id` (hashed) and `customer_meta` as a map of allowed keys defined per-customer. Anything else goes to `redacted_fields` list.

Evan: Operational concerns: ingest throughput can spike due to batching metadata — e.g., 512 requests merged into a single batch produce a giant `tokens_generated` but small per-request `seq_len`. We should log both `batch_total_tokens` and per-request `seq_len`. That helps in capacity planning.

Aisha: Adding `batch_total_tokens` and `batch_size`. Also we should include `queue_time_ms` (time in router before hitting runtime) — important for latency SLOs.

ingest-bot: schema-validator: warning — current schema draft missing `service_env` and `deployment_id`. These are required by platform for routing cost attribution.

Ben: ingest-bot is right — add those. Also we need `node_region` vs `customer_region` to help detect cross-region egress costs.

Aisha: Updated minimal JSON schema (draft):
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["timestamp","model","model_version","route","seq_len","tokens_generated","latency_ms","prompt_hash","service_env","deployment_id"],
  "properties": {
    "timestamp": {"type":"string","format":"date-time"},
    "model": {"type":"string"},
    "model_version": {"type":"string"},
    "route": {"type":"string"},
    "batch_id": {"type":"string"},
    "batch_size": {"type":"integer"},
    "batch_total_tokens": {"type":"integer"},
    "seq_len": {"type":"integer"},
    "tokens_generated": {"type":"integer"},
    "latency_ms": {"type":"number"},
    "queue_time_ms": {"type":"number"},
    "kv_cache_hit": {"type":"boolean"},
    "error": {"type":"boolean"},
    "prompt_hash": {"type":"string"},
    "sample_reason": {"type":"string"},
    "sample_decision_id": {"type":"string"},
    "service_env": {"type":"string"},
    "deployment_id": {"type":"string"},
    "node_region": {"type":"string"},
    "customer_region": {"type":"string"},
    "redacted_fields": {"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}
  }
}
```

Clara: +1 on schema. For alert tuning: we should avoid noise from occasional long seq_len jobs. Use 99th percentile over 5m for latency alerts and use an adaptive baseline per-model. Also create a composite alert: high tokens_generated rate AND increased latency to catch cost-induced slowdowns.

Evan: Grafana dashboards: we need panels for token rate by model, avg cost_per_token, cache_hit_rate, and a panel that maps `batch_size` distribution. Also add an alert that fires when `token_rate` increases > 3x baseline for a region for >10m.

Ben: Implementation plan: 1) finalize schema PR in infra/logging repo, 2) add ingest sampler to canary region (eu-west1) behind a feature flag, 3) update transform jobs to emit metrics to Prometheus via the streaming metrics bridge, 4) run canary for 48h, then roll 25/50/100.

Aisha: I'll open the PR today with docs and sample configs. Can everyone review in the next 48h? If approved we'll schedule the canary for next Tuesday.

Clara: I'll update SLO dashboard templates and add draft alert thresholds.

Evan: I'll wire the metrics bridge and add the batch panels.

ingest-bot: deploy-bot: note — when rolling, instrumented services must emit `sample_decision_id` or logs will be rejected by transform.

Aisha: Thanks all. I'll include a short migration guide for SDK teams (how to compute `prompt_hash`, where to put sanitized customer metadata).
